propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate multi-AC ticket validation, marking valid criteria as unmet simply due to insufficient proof budget (not runaway), causing operators to resort to attestation workarounds.

Current budget formula (8 steps/criterion, 48-480 floor) ignores evidence-surface scaling (child ticket traversal, fixed overhead) and offers no cross-run PASS-verdict reuse, forcing re-verification of proven criteria (~10 min/cycle).

Step budget defaults must be raised (24 steps/criterion, 160-960 floor) with per-child traversal term (16 steps/child) and fixed overhead (16 steps) so epic criteria scale appropriately and runaway guards remain authoritative backstop.

A new persistent cross-run PASS-verdict cache keyed by criterion text hash and scoped content fingerprint (git blob SHAs of file_impact paths, unrelated commits do NOT invalidate) must seed still-valid entries into re-verification runs, excluding them from primary work and protecting them from finalizer downgrades.

Seeded cached PASS verdicts must be immune to finalizer judgment (echoed downgrades replaced by the bank record, omissions appended) while same-run non-seeded downgrades remain preserved; fingerprint invalidation on criterion text or file_impact content change; ref-bound fingerprinting ensures verdicts from --ref targeted verification are not reused at differing HEAD.
